description_en: Queries the list of cross-account DNS transfers based on the specified parameters
description_zh: 根据传入参数获取跨账号转移DNS列表
name: DescribeTransferDomains

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English.
Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。

取值：

zh：中文 

en：英文

   默认取值为zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of the current page. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The transfer type. Valid values:
IN: domain names transferred to the current account.
OUT: domain names transferred from the current account
parameters.help_zh:
转移类型。取值范围：

IN：转入到本账号的列表
OUT：本账号转出的列表
parameters.name: transfer_type

parameters.help_en: The domain name. Specify a domain name to query its transfer records
parameters.help_zh: 域名名称，查询指定域名的转移记录
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the source account. Specify this parameter to view the list of domain names transferred from the specified account to the current account
parameters.help_zh: 域名来源账号ID，查看从该ID账号转移给本账号的域名列表
parameters.name: from_user_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the destination account. Specify this parameter to view the list of domain names transferred from the current account to the specified account
parameters.help_zh: 域名去处账号ID，查看从本账号转移给该ID账号的域名列表
parameters.name: target_user_id

PageNumber.description_en: The number of the current page. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1

PageSize.description_en: The Settings for the number of entries per page during paging in a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值100，默认为20

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
